creator: Alexander Terp
description:
amterp, Chat Notes 2026-10-18: "confirm on cmd +q". At triage on 2026-10-21 he settled the shape: ⌘Q asks, offering both quits, and leaving the agents running is the default that Return picks.

⌘Q is the menu's "Quit muster, Leaving Sessions Running" (`Sources/MusterMac/AppMenu.swift`), and it quits without asking. Nothing is lost, since every agent keeps running and every window reopens at the next launch, but a stray ⌘Q costs a relaunch. "Quit and Close Sessions" has its own menu item and already asks first, with a sheet that names each machine, its pane count and its directories (`QuitSummary.swift`, a_28YghIUw2).

Wanted: ⌘Q opens one question offering:
- Quit, leaving sessions running: the default button.
- Quit and close sessions.

Think this through before building, because the owner was unsure what the second option ends. Today it ends every daemon the app is attached to (`session::quitting` in `crates/muster-seam/src/session.rs`): a devenv's too, stopped through its ssh master, and a daemon Muster adopted rather than started, which the sheet warns about. It also forgets every window, so the next launch opens a fresh one. Open: whether the question offers finer choices, such as this machine only or only the daemons Muster started, and whether a setting turns the question off.
title: ⌘Q asks before quitting, with leaving sessions running as the default
